title: Guzar gayi fatima jahaa'n se
body:
Guzar gayi fatima jahaa'n se, Yateem hai chote chote bache
Ali hai ghar me bas ab akele, Yateem hai chote chote bache
utha ke ranjo alam sidhaare'n, bala ke seh seh ke gham sidhaare'n
ujad gaya ghar hue ye sadme, Yateem hai chote chote bache
<<DIVIDER>>
jo chot lagti hai nanhe dil par, to maa ki mayyat ke paas aakar
pukaarte hai lipat lipat kar, Yateem hai chote chote bache
ye roke farma rahe hai hyder, palenge mujhse sagheer kyu'n kar
inhe'n koi kis tarah sambhaale, Yateem hai chote chote bache
<<DIVIDER>>
ab in ko neend aaye shab ko kyu'n kar, thapak ke jisko sulaae maadar
the maa ke pehlu me sone waale, Yateem hai chote chote bache
ye qoob tha mujhko mout aati, magar na zahra ki jaan jaati
ye laal kyu'n kar palenge mujh se, Yateem hai chote chote bache
